svg.aria-label: A background thread lists units, claims the next one with put_if_absent and loads its batches in step order, then goes back for another unit. It fills a buffer of eight batches; six are ready, steps 61 to 66. The training loop takes the oldest batch, moves it to the device, sets the learning rate for its step, trains and reports to the session. When the buffer is full the thread waits; when no unclaimed unit is left it ends, and the loop drains the buffer and stops.
svg.text: list units/, skip the claimed ones
load(unit): its batches, in step order
after the unit's last batch, back to 1
no unclaimed unit left: the thread ends
drains the buffer, then leaves the loop
While the GPU trains on one batch, the thread reads ahead, up to eight batches.
A loader or mailbox error reaches the loop after the batches already buffered.
